So because when I hear we're going to make something for kids and then they can just search the AUR and install something then I would think that is a recipe for disaster. And the reason I say that is not because I would hate for something with Omarchy with this publicity to get like a huge hack and get a huge you know negative publicity. Right. That's that I'm not saying this because I want to hate on Omarchy.
turns.zh: 嗯，这很好。因为当我听说我们要为孩子们做东西，然后他们可以搜索 AUR 并安装东西，我会认为那是灾难的配方。我这么说的原因不是因为我讨厌 Omarchy 在这样宣传下被大规模黑客攻击并得到巨大的负面宣传。对。我不是因为想讨厌 Omarchy 才这么说。

turns.en: No no but that's the thing, that's the thing that I would hate to see right now with this momentum. So that and same here that's why literally in the groups I've stated number one priority is security that we need to make sure that this is now that doesn't mean we're going to catch everything I mean the number of CVEs that are published every day for the Linux kernel is long, most of them are not kind of zero day remote execution issues some of them are rather secure or issues right we need to fix all of that whether it comes from upstream whether it's in our package and I 100% agree. When I talk about the Wild West, I'm talking about informed or less informed. I'm talking about adults. Once you're an adult and you own your own computer, it is my belief you should be able to do whatever the hell you want with that now. Well, within the laws, right? Like don't use your computer for whatever. But even if you do, that's actually not within my limit, right? I'm selling you a fork and a spoon. If you use that fork and a spoon to, I don't know, dig out a prison or shank someone, I can't be taking responsibility for that. And I don't think that's a good path to go for. Kids, very different. Kids, you need to enable the adults in their life, their parents first and foremost, to protect them reasonably. And that's what we're going to do with Omarchy kits. Here's a version of Omarchy or path of Omarchy that you set up for a child where they do not have access to sudo. They have access to a limited whitelisted DNS for using the web if that's what you want to use. They have either time limits or time nudges. That's what all that work needs to be. I would not today think, oh, I should just give an Omarchy machine to a child with no instruction about anything, no help. Now, I'm saying that and then I also remember my own childhood and running an elite BBS system out of my bedroom at 14, trading piracy software. Um, so I don't know.
turns.zh: 不，不，但这就是问题所在，这就是我现在不想看到的事情，尤其是在这种势头下。所以，同样，这就是为什么我在群里明确表示第一要务是安全，我们需要确保这一点。这并不意味着我们能抓住所有问题，我的意思是 Linux 内核每天发布的 CVE 数量很多，大多数不是零日远程执行问题，有些是安全或问题，我们需要修复所有这些，无论是来自上游还是我们的包中，我百分百同意。当我谈论狂野西部时，我指的是知情或不知情。我指的是成年人。一旦你是成年人并拥有自己的电脑，我相信你应该能够为所欲为。好吧，在法律范围内，对吧？比如不要用你的电脑做任何事。但即使你做了，那实际上不在我的限制范围内，对吧？我卖给你一把叉子和勺子。如果你用那把叉子和勺子去，我不知道，挖出监狱或刺伤某人，我不能为此负责。我不认为那是一条好路。孩子们，非常不同。孩子们，你需要让他们生活中的成年人，首先是父母，能够合理地保护他们。这就是我们要用 Omarchy 套件做的。这里有一个为儿童设置的 Omarchy 版本或路径，他们无法访问 sudo。他们可以访问有限的白名单 DNS 来使用网络，如果你想用的话。他们有要么时间限制要么时间提醒。这就是所有工作需要做的。我今天不会想，哦，我应该直接给一个孩子一台 Omarchy 机器，没有任何指导，没有帮助。现在，我这么说，然后我也记得我自己的童年，14 岁时在卧室里运行一个精英 BBS 系统，交易盗版软件。嗯，所以我不知道。

turns.en: I mean, sometimes I have it a little bit of both ways, but either way, I want Omarchy to be a place that parents can trust and we have work to do there. It's not there yet, but we're going to get started very soon. There's a whole team. There's a Discord channel with literally hundreds of people working on this, not just from the technical perspective, but also from the art—like we're doing very specific kids themes that are just wholesome and nice and all the other stuff. And then for adults, I'm saying right now, hey, do you know what? Omarchy is not Ubuntu. It's not trying to be it at this point. It is still in the pioneer to early adopter stage. And those people should have access to the frontier. They should have access to the Wild West. It should be separate. There should be a part of it that's like here's town. There's a sheriff and if someone comes in there, he's going to take care of it. That's our own packages. And that's our Arch bootstrapping. And then also right over there, Wild West.
turns.zh: 我的意思是，有时候我两种方式都有一点，但无论如何，我希望 Omarchy 成为一个家长可以信任的地方，我们在这方面还有工作要做。它还没达到那个程度，但我们很快就会开始。有一整个团队。有一个 Discord 频道，有数百人在为此工作，不仅从技术角度，还有艺术方面——比如我们在做非常具体的儿童主题，就是健康、美好以及所有其他东西。然后对于成年人，我现在说的是，嘿，你知道吗？Omarchy 不是 Ubuntu。它目前并不想成为它。它仍然处于先驱到早期采用者的阶段。那些人应该能够接触到前沿。他们应该能够接触到狂野西部。它应该是分开的。应该有一部分像是：这里是城镇。有治安官，如果有人进来，他会处理。那是我们自己的软件包。那是我们的 Arch 引导。然后就在那边，狂野西部。

turns.en: Yeah. Well, I'm really glad we could clarify this because like when you just look at your X timeline, or when you say Omarchy for kids, then things can get taken out of context.
turns.zh: 是的。嗯，我真的很高兴我们能澄清这一点，因为就像当你只看你的 X 时间线，或者当你说 Omarchy 儿童版时，事情可能会被断章取义。

turns.en: Yes.
turns.zh: 是的。

turns.en: And myself included, I also came to conclusions based on just that information. So, I'm really glad that you say that security is a first priority. We're working on Omarchy for kids. Like there's not more that I could wish for. So that's really awesome to hear.
turns.zh: 包括我自己，我也仅基于那些信息就下了结论。所以，我真的很高兴你说安全是第一要务。我们正在为儿童开发 Omarchy。我不能再奢求更多了。所以听到这个真的很棒。

turns.en: This is why podcasts are so much better for recent exchange. Like on X, we have 240 characters. And even if I tweet about security, most of the time if I'm just tweeting positive things about security, it doesn't travel because like what people want to see is a dead body in the streets, right? So it'll travel if there's someone who finds something, but it won't travel if I just go like, "Hey, here's all these positive things we're doing about security." So podcasting is a much better format for that. And we also have a fairly in-depth security page on omarchy.org/security that details the responsible disclosure protocol, the team, what we're doing, and all this other stuff. So take it incredibly serious. It is foundational. If you're not focused on that in today's world, you're not going to make it.
turns.zh: 这就是为什么播客更适合最近的交流。就像在 X 上，我们只有 240 个字符。即使我发关于安全的推文，大多数时候如果我只是发关于安全的积极事情，它不会传播，因为人们想看到的是街上的尸体，对吧？所以如果有人发现了什么，它会传播，但如果我只是说“嘿，这是我们正在做的所有关于安全的积极事情”，它就不会传播。所以播客是更好的格式。我们还在 omarchy.org/security 上有一个相当深入的安全页面，详细说明了负责任的披露协议、团队、我们正在做的事情以及所有其他东西。所以我们非常认真地对待它。它是基础性的。如果你在当今世界不关注这一点，你就不会成功。

turns.en: Exactly. Well, I think that's a really good statement to end the podcast with. David, thank you so much for what you are doing for Linux, desktop Linux. And I can only imagine what positive effect it's going to have for kids to grow up with a tiling window manager instead of an iPad. If I had a kid, like that would be the first thing I would do is try to find some Linux distribution that they could start using from day one. So, thank you for all of your effort, time, money, what you're putting into this and keep up the good work, man.
turns.zh: 确实。嗯，我认为这是结束播客的一个非常好的陈述。David，非常感谢你为 Linux、桌面 Linux 所做的一切。我只能想象孩子们在平铺窗口管理器而不是 iPad 中长大将会产生多么积极的影响。如果我有孩子，那会是我要做的第一件事，就是尝试找到一些他们可以从第一天就开始使用的 Linux 发行版。所以，感谢你所有的努力、时间、金钱，你投入的一切，继续做好工作，伙计。

turns.en: Thank you so much. Thanks for having me on.
turns.zh: 非常感谢。感谢邀请我。

turns.en: David, where can people find you?
turns.zh: David，人们可以在哪里找到你？

turns.en: They can find the Omarchy project on omarchy.org. That's omarchy—I'm spelling it out because it doesn't always pronounce like it spells—omarchy.org. That's the portal to everything. And then my personal website is just dhh.dk. So that's where you can get everything I'm involved with both in the commercial side with Basecamp, Ruby on Rails, books I've written, whatever else. And then omarchy.org is everything for the project.
turns.zh: 他们可以在 omarchy.org 上找到 Omarchy 项目。就是 omarchy——我拼出来是因为它不总是按拼写发音——omarchy.org。那是通往一切的门户。然后我的个人网站是 dhh.dk。所以在那里你可以找到我参与的一切，包括商业方面的 Basecamp、Ruby on Rails、我写的书等等。然后 omarchy.org 是项目的一切。

turns.en: And we'll be putting all those links down in the description below.
turns.zh: 我们会把所有这些链接放在下面的描述中。

consensus.en: Linux is the perfect fit for AI because everything is a CLI, config file, and scriptable.
consensus.zh: Linux 是 AI 的完美选择，因为一切皆 CLI、配置文件且可脚本化。

consensus.en: Agents have made Linux debugging and development dramatically easier and more accessible.
consensus.zh: 智能体让 Linux 调试和开发变得异常简单且更易上手。

consensus.en: Security is the number one priority for Omarchy, with a dedicated team and responsible disclosure.
consensus.zh: 安全是 Omarchy 的首要任务，拥有专门团队和负责任披露流程。

consensus.en: Omarchy aims to reach escape velocity with enough users to sustain the project long-term.
consensus.zh: Omarchy 旨在达到逃逸速度，拥有足够用户以长期维持项目。

consensus.en: The AUR is not used by default in Omarchy; users must opt-in and can review packages.
consensus.zh: Omarchy 默认不使用 AUR；用户必须选择加入并可审查软件包。

consensus.en: Omarchy for kids will be locked down with no sudo access and parental controls.
consensus.zh: 面向儿童的 Omarchy 将锁定，无 sudo 权限并设有家长控制。

contrarian.en: AI agents now write better code than most professional programmers, including DHH.
contrarian.zh: AI 智能体现在比大多数专业程序员（包括 DHH）写出更好的代码。

contrarian.en: The Linux community's hostility to AI and marketing is a trap that hinders progress.
contrarian.zh: Linux 社区对 AI 和营销的敌意是一个阻碍进步的陷阱。

contrarian.en: Warning popups and nanny screens are ineffective because users ignore them.
contrarian.zh: 警告弹窗和保姆式屏幕无效，因为用户会忽略它们。

contrarian.en: The AUR is a valuable resource despite security risks, and we shouldn't throw it out.
contrarian.zh: 尽管有安全风险，AUR 仍是宝贵资源，我们不应抛弃它。

contrarian.en: Linux desktop can capture 20-30% market share, challenging Mac and Windows.
contrarian.zh: Linux 桌面可以占据 20-30% 的市场份额，挑战 Mac 和 Windows。

contrarian.en: The current desktop paradigm is an acquired taste; tiling window managers are only difficult for adults.
contrarian.zh: 当前的桌面范式是一种习得品味；平铺窗口管理器只对成年人困难。
